name: Integrated Optics
description: Guided TE and TM modes of symmetric and asymmetric planar waveguides: step-index and graded-index waveguides. Strip, channel, slot and silicon waveguides and anisotropic waveguides, Marcatili’s method, effective-index method and perturbation method of analysis. Directional couplers, coupled mode analysis of uniform and reverse delta-beta couplers, ring resonators. Applications as power splitters, Y-junction, electro-optic and thermo-optic modulators, optical switch; filters, Y-splitters, mode splitters, polarization splitters; Mach-Zehnder interferometer based devices, fiber and integrated optical devices, simulation tools for waveguide designs. Integrated optical amplifiers, nano-photonic-devices: metal/dielectric plasmonic waveguides, long and short range surface plasmon modes supported by thin metal films, applications in integrated waveguide polarizers. Integrated photonic sensors: temperature, strain, and chemical and bio-sensing. Fabrication and characterisation of integrated optical waveguides and devices. Waveguide coupling: prism coupling and grating coupling. Nonlinear effects in integrated optical waveguides.
